name: Sticker behind an object
description: A logo, picture or video in the scene that disappears behind a wall, a pillar or a car: one click on the object makes a mask of its even surface, the object stays in front and both follow a tracker.
description_de: Ein Logo, Bild oder Video in der Szene, das hinter einer Wand, einer Säule oder einem Auto verschwindet: ein Klick auf das Objekt macht aus seiner gleichfarbigen Fläche eine Maske, das Objekt bleibt davor und beides folgt einem Tracker.
description_en: A logo, picture or video in the scene that disappears behind a wall, a pillar or a car: one click on the object makes a mask of its even surface, the object stays in front and both follow a tracker.
note: Pick the object in front: {op:'pick_region', clip, at, point:[x, y], add:true} (0..1 of the picture; look with `frames` first) makes mask 6 the outline of the even surface you point at and puts tracker 2's point on structure at its edge; combine:'add' / 'subtract' adds or takes away another surface. Then {op:'track_node', clip, node:2} so sticker and mask stay in the scene when the camera moves. Check with `frames` {clip, node:7}.

x.description: where it sits, 0..1 from the left

y.description: where it sits, 0..1 from the top

size.description: size of the sticker (1 = full picture)

soft.description: soft edge of the object's outline in project pixels
